events.title: Next Fest Launch Stream: Playing the MoonStreet Demo Live
events.summary: Hey guys! Steam Next Fest starts now, and I'm going live to play the MoonStreet demo from the beginning.Drop into chat and ask me anything about Keith, Max, how the game was made, or what's coming in the full game! The demo is free on this page, and a wishlist helps a lot :)Times: Tue 20 Oct, 01:00 Singapore / Mon 19 Oct, 10:00 PDT / 19:00 CEST.

events.title: The MoonStreet demo is out now for Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone! The MoonStreet demo is out now on Steam, and it’s part of Steam Next Fest from October 19 to 26.You play Keith Klipper, a scientist with a small robot called M.A.X. at his side. Keith has one job: deliver a device he built to Tower Futuristics, the largest corporation in the city of Astro.
